name: flux-render
description: Universal format converter. Renders Flux NDJSON as JSON, Markdown, CSV or YAML (and back) -- the interchange layer with the outside world.
author: takakix2
notes: transform-kind: this pipe consumes a Flux NDJSON stream on stdin. `verbs` is empty because hermes cannot bind a transform yet -- `register_verb` (hsh-hermes/src/stream/mod.rs) dispatches on the argument types alone and ignores `kind`, so every verb it registers is a *source* (`from_command_inproc`). Declaring one here would bind flux-render as a constructor and run it with no stdin: recognised, highlighted, completed -- and broken. That is exactly the "looks supported but isn't" failure hsh removed in 7047377. Until hermes grows transform verbs (sugar over the existing `.pipe_to`, which works today), reach it as `<source>.pipe_to("flux-render")` or as a plain command in a shell pipeline.
